Group findings by inspection?

This replaces the current mixed finding order. Findings from each inspection will be placed together, preserving their current order within that inspection.

Inspections follow their first appearance in the current finding order. Finding numbers and exports will update. This applies to the whole report, including findings hidden by filters.

Install Report Studio

Open this site in a supported browser while online. Use the browser’s Install app or Add to Home Screen command. On iPhone or iPad, use Safari’s Share menu → Add to Home Screen.

Wait for Ready for offline use before disconnecting. Saved reports, ZIP imports, photo editing and exports can then run locally. First-time sign-in and updates need an internet connection.

Installed status depends on what your browser can detect. If an app is already installed but this browser cannot detect it, open it from your device’s apps. Installed and browser copies may use separate storage; use a project backup to move reports.

App updates do not erase saved reports. Keep project backups because browser or device cleanup can still remove local data.

About Safety Fieldbook Report Studio
Version 1.2.3 · Updated 10 Nov 2026
Safety Fieldbook Report Studio turns inspection records into clear, shareable reports. Import one or more Safety Fieldbook ZIPs, review and organise findings, edit photographs, and export to Word, PDF or PowerPoint. Reports and edits are saved in your browser, with offline access after initial setup. Download a project backup to protect your work or continue on another device.
NUS ORMC
KB Goh, with inputs from WY Wong
Create a report, add your Safety Fieldbook ZIPs, review the findings, then preview and download.


Start a report and import ZIPs
  1. Select Create report on the home screen.
  2. Choose Add Safety Fieldbook ZIPs, or drop files into the upload panel. You can import several inspections from different dates into one report.
  3. Review any import warnings. Duplicate records are checked; conflicting versions require you to choose which version to keep.
Use Safety Fieldbook schema 3 ZIP exports. Limits: 200 MB per ZIP, 500 MB total ZIPs per report and 1 GB expanded data. Large reports also depend on available browser memory and storage.


Edit report details and findings
Use Edit report details to change the title, preparation date, inspectors and optional report information. Inspector names are initially consolidated from inspections with active findings.
Click a finding card or its pencil icon to edit. Use a short title to name the issue and Observation for the full evidence. Add a recommended corrective action where appropriate. Category, priority and remarks are under Additional details. Select Save changes to apply edits or Cancel to keep the previous finding.
Use search and Filters to find records. Filters change the workspace view; all active findings remain in the export.


Reorder, merge or delete findings
Drag the grip beside the finding number to reorder cards. The card menu also provides position controls. Report numbering and exports follow the findings order.
Use Select findings to select and merge related findings from the same inspection. Review the combined wording and photographs. Undo merge restores the original findings.
The trash icon deletes a finding from this report. Use Filters to view deleted findings and restore them. Original inspection records remain unchanged.


Add and edit photographs
Open a finding and select Add photos. JPEG and PNG files are supported, up to 20 MB per photo and 20 files per selection.
Click a photograph to crop, rotate or annotate it. Edits create a report copy and preserve the imported image. Review the result before saving.
Use the Include checkbox to choose report photographs. Add an optional caption below each image. Use the trash icon to remove a photo, then Undo to restore it. Restore removed photos brings back all removed photos in that finding. Save the finding to keep these changes.


Preview and export
Compact individual findings uses smaller photos and allows findings to share Word/PDF pages when space permits. Compact photo appendix groups photographs from several findings in consolidated reports. Keep the spacious layout for detailed evidence; long captions automatically retain a larger layout.
Select Preview & export. Open Export options to choose individual finding tables or a consolidated findings table, select report fields and add blank department response space. Recommended corrective action and department response are separate fields.
Word is editable; PDF is ready to share; PowerPoint provides presentation slides. Consolidated Word/PDF tables use landscape pages and a photo appendix. Slide and page breaks may differ from the preview. Long content or additional photographs may continue on another page or slide.
Review advisory checks, wording, photographs and the downloaded file before sharing. An exported report does not contain the full editable project.


Autosave, backups and moving devices
To delete a saved report, open its ⋯ menu on the home screen and choose Delete report. You can back it up before confirming. Use Undo or Recently deleted to restore it, including its photos and edits. Deleted reports remain in browser storage.
Reports are autosaved in this browser. In a finding editor, select Save changes to commit the draft. Check the save status; if saving fails, download a project backup before leaving.
Select Back up project to keep a separate copy with photographs and edits. On the home screen, use Open project backup to continue it.
Reports do not sync between browsers, devices or website addresses. Browser data cleanup can remove them. To move from the earlier ChatGPT Site, download a project backup there and open it here.


Install, work offline and update
Use the app control in the header. It shows Install app, Installed or Update available. Installation depends on your browser; instructions are shown when a direct install prompt is unavailable. Installed status appears when the browser can detect it.
Wait for Ready for offline use before disconnecting. You can then reopen the cached app, edit locally stored reports, import local files and export reports. Initial setup and updates require internet access.
When Update available appears, save open edits and close other app tabs or windows before applying it. Keep a project backup before updating.


Delete report?
This moves the report and its photographs to Recently deleted in this browser. You can restore it later. Download a project backup first if you need a separate copy.
